subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states received the maximum of its rainfall from the Northeast Monsoon in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **Tamil Nadu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Tamil Nadu, the state experiences the maximum **North-East monsoon rainfall**.
 
• The **southwest monsoon** is the exact opposite, known as a monsoon of summer that blows from sea to land, while the **northeast monsoon** is typically known as a monsoon of winter that blows from the land towards the sea.
 
• The North-East monsoon typically lasts from **October to March**, though this might vary from year to year.
 
• The monsoons in the northeast are known as **retreating monsoons**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
